title: Git operations via shelling out
description: Why this module shells out to git instead of linking a library.
body: This shells out to the system git binary rather than linking a library (git2). A deliberate trade: the user's credential helper, SSH agent, .gitconfig, hooks and aliases are all things git already knows about and a linked library would have to be taught. The cost is that every answer arrives as text that has to be parsed. Everything here is one-shot request→reply: there is no watcher and no subscription.
